تستعبدون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْبِدُونَ (tastaʕbidūna) /tas.taʕ.bi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# تُسْتَعْبَدُونَ (tustaʕbadūna) /tus.taʕ.ba.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
